parts.text: Specs are structured artifacts that turn high-level ideas into detailed implementation plans with clear tracking and accountability.
Kiro asks if you are developing a Feature or fixing a Bug.
Bug analysis with current, expected and unchanged behavior in bugfix.md.
Auto-generates all three artifacts without approval gates.
requirements.md captures user stories, acceptance criteria, or bug analysis in structured notation.
Break down requirements into user stories with acceptance criteria.
design.md documents technical architecture, sequence diagrams, and implementation considerations.
tasks.md provides a detailed implementation plan with discrete, trackable tasks.
Real-time status updates as you implement.
Run tasks individually or all at once.
Kiro builds a dependency graph and groups independent tasks into waves. Waves run in order; tasks within a wave run together.
